stories.title: Arkansas announces over $2.83 million in total relief for consumers in Acima settlement
stories.summary: Arkansas consumers could see money back and debt reductions under a new $183.5 million settlement that was reached with rent-to-own company Acima.

stories.title: Arkansas joins FTC and 12 other states in lawsuit challenging merger between Covetrus and MWI supply veterinary clinics
stories.summary: According to AG Griffin, the acquisition would eliminate competition, which would consequently cause prices to increase for both local businesses and consumers.

stories.title: UCA names new football coach as Steve Campbell returns to lead Bears
stories.summary: UCA announced Sunday that Steve Campbell is returning to lead the Bears after previously coaching the team from 2014 to 2017.

stories.title: Man found dead in Little Rock parking lot after shooting
stories.summary: Little Rock police are investigating a fatal shooting after a man was found dead from gunshot wounds in a parking lot.

stories.title: One dead after early morning shooting in Little Rock, suspect arrested
stories.summary: The Little Rock Police Department is investigating a homicide after officers responded to a scene where a man was found suffering from gunshot wounds.

stories.title: Final scores for Week 12: Playoffs of Arkansas high school football
stories.summary: Here are your final scores for Week 12: Playoffs of Arkansas high school football!

stories.title: Dunbar to feed community with No Cost Market
stories.summary: The Dunbar Historic Neighborhood Association is set to host its No Cost Market Saturday, allowing Little Rock residents to receive needed food items.

stories.title: Pulaski County data center lawsuit hearing focuses on proposed agreement
stories.summary: AVAIO Digital has requested a preliminary injunction to temporarily block enforcement of Pulaski County’s data center regulations while the lawsuit continues.

stories.title: Arkansas confirms five measles cases ahead of holiday travel season
stories.summary: Arkansas has had five confirmed measles cases, prompting Department of Health officials to urge parents to vaccinate their children ahead of the holiday travel.

stories.title: Arkansas State Police seize over $2M in drugs in trio of traffic stops
stories.summary: Arkansas State Police said they seized over $2 million in suspected illegal drugs during three recent traffic stops.

stories.title: What's next for downtown Little Rock? New survey seeks public input
stories.summary: City leaders are seeking public input on the future of downtown Little Rock, including potential improvements to public safety, vacant buildings & new development.

stories.title: Two Little Rock annex proposals draw concern over infrastructure and landscape integrity
stories.summary: The City of Little Rock is proposing two annexes to extend city limits for residential housing, whilst residents claim it would slow traffic and emergency services.
